rows: Christ died for me while I was still a sinner. His love runs that deep.
God loved me first, long before I turned toward Him.
God gave His only Son for me. Eternal life is mine forever.
Jesus laid down His life for me. There is no greater love.

God saved me by mercy, not by anything I did.

The Father Himself loves me, because I love His Son.

Through Christ who loves me, I am more than a conqueror.

God has blessed me in Christ with every spiritual blessing in heaven.

Before I was formed in the womb, God knew me and set me apart.

I live by faith in the Son of God who gave Himself for me.

I move when God says move, before I see where it leads.
Everything is possible for the one who believes, and I believe.
I walk by faith, not by what my eyes report.
